trophies.guide:
1. Earn the other 54 trophies and this one is awarded on its own — there is no separate task for the platinum. [1][5]
2. Every one of the 54 is single-player and offline, so no online play and no DLC is needed, and one playthrough is enough. [1][2]
3. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours; Push Square puts it above 250 hours — both figures are shown, not averaged. [1][9]
4. If it has not popped, filter the tracker to Unearned and clear the shortest remaining stage first. [1][3]
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide:
1. Play the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 — the trophy pops when the mission ends. [1][5][7]
2. It is automatic: nothing extra in the mission is needed for this trophy. [1]
3. Story trophies cannot be missed; the mission is on the main path and always available. [1][5]
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 1 — the trophy pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? [1][5]
2. It is automatic and story-only; no side content is needed. [1]
3. Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for trophy 28 — it is the one action in the game that may not come back. [1]
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 2 — the trophy pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. [1][5]
2. It is automatic and story-only; no side content is needed. [1]
3. Chapter 2 is where free-roam together first opens, after Coffee Break, which the partner trophies need. [1]
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 3 — the trophy pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. [1][5]
2. It is automatic and story-only; no side content is needed. [1]
3. Chapter 3 is where several side chains start (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) — begin each when it appears. [1]
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide:
1. Finish Chapter 4 — the trophy pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. [1][5]
2. It is automatic and story-only; no side content is needed. [1]
3. Note: one guide's text repeats this chapter for the final mission too, so this guide does not assign the final mission to a chapter — it just says final mission. [1]
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide:
1. Complete the final mission — the trophy pops when it ends. [1][5]
2. It is automatic and story-only; no side content is needed. [1]
3. The final mission's chapter is not pinned down cleanly by the guides, so this guide calls it the final mission and gives no chapter number. [1]
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide:
1. Play the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 — the trophy pops when it ends. [1][5]
2. It is automatic; nothing extra in the mission is needed for this trophy. [1]
3. Story trophies cannot be missed; the mission is on the main path. [1][5]
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide:
1. Play the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 — the trophy pops when it ends. [1][5]
2. It is automatic; nothing extra in the mission is needed for this trophy. [1]
3. Story trophies cannot be missed; the mission is on the main path. [1][5]
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide:
1. Play the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4 — the trophy pops when it ends. [1][5]
2. It is automatic; nothing extra in the mission is needed for this trophy. [1]
3. Story trophies cannot be missed; the mission is on the main path. [1][5]
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide:
1. Play the mission Headliners in Chapter 4 — the trophy pops when it ends. [1][5]
2. It is automatic; nothing extra in the mission is needed for this trophy. [1]
3. Story trophies cannot be missed; the mission is on the main path. [1][5]
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide:
1. Play the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 — the trophy pops when it ends. [1][5]
2. It is automatic; nothing extra in the mission is needed for this trophy. [1]
3. Story trophies cannot be missed; the mission is on the main path. [1][5]
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide:
1. Play the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 — the trophy pops when it ends. [1][5]
2. It is automatic; nothing extra in the mission is needed for this trophy. [1]
3. Story trophies cannot be missed; the mission is on the main path. [1][5]
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide:
1. Open the checklist after the story at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — progress made during the story already counts. [1][2][5]
2. Work the checklist lines in the 100% Ledger view: most need only a part (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations), while robberies, shooting ranges, drone races, Target Decks, bank jobs and gang operations need everything. [1][3][8]
3. Nothing on the checklist is missable and everything is doable in free roam after the credits. [1][6]
4. The checklist is closer to 60% true completion; PowerPyx puts this step at about 100 hours, and the whole run at about 200 hours, while Push Square puts the total above 250 hours. [1][9]
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide:
1. Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — the four kinds are 130 Stunt Jumps (ramps), 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights (between buildings) and 25 Base Jumps (parachute) — and mix them freely. [1][5]
2. Under the Bridges are the quickest to clear, so sweep those first when you are short on count. [1]
3. Track progress by region at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and by name on the map under Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots. [1]
4. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 — the counter tracks 300 for that list. [1][8]
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
1. Try each of the 9 activity types once — the trophy tracker counts 9 — and view them at Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. [1][5]
2. The types are Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), Playing a Video Game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun Drone Race), and Performing a Stunt. [1]
3. Most of these come on their own from the story and from unfogging the map, so check the tracker before going out of your way. [1]
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
1. Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — there are 12 Shooting Range locations and 42 gold medals in total. [1][5]
2. Work one location at a time and use the range's own scoring to see which challenges still need gold. [1]
3. Shooting Range golds also raise the Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy later. [1]
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
1. Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. [1][5]
2. All 14 locations are needed for the 100% checklist too, so this trophy and that line finish together. [1]
3. Learn each course's line before racing for the win; a clean run beats a fast crash. [1]
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide:
1. Win 20 different races — there are 40 unique race locations in total, so you can skip the ones you dislike. [1][5]
2. Race wins also feed the activity types for trophy 16, so do a few early. [1]
3. All 40 locations are still available after the story, so there is no rush. [1]
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
1. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts a fishing location, marked with a purple map icon — follow his fishing questline. [1][5]
2. Beat him in a fishing challenge to pop the trophy. [1]
3. The chain stays available after the story, so you can finish it in free roam. [1]
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide:
1. Complete one arcade game — the four in-game games are Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. [1][5]
2. The first three are on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (temporarily unavailable in some story sections, still doable after the story); the fourth is at arcade machines in the world. [1]
3. Complete means finishing all levels once — there is no need to beat every challenge. [1]
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
1. Andy's questline is Lucia-only and is marked automatically in Chapter 3 — Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. [1][2]
2. Finish the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse). [1]
3. Start it when it appears in Chapter 3 — it is still available after the story, but it is Lucia-only, so do it as her. [1][5]
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
1. Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls, and a green KR icon appears in Key Lento. [1][2]
2. Treasure diving: he marks purple chest icons — find the underwater treasures with a metal detector and bring them back. [1]
3. There are 7 shipwrecks in total; track them at Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. [1]
4. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 — call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 to speed it up; he is NOT missable. [1][5]
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
1. Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. [1][2]
2. Finish the five quests: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes. [1]
3. It stays available after the story, so finish it in free roam if you like. [1][5]
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — only certain questlines count, and the tracker in the trophy list shows your count. [1][5]
2. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk (Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm quests), Yago (street-race quests) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and deliveries) — more strangers are yet to be discovered. [1][3]
3. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count as strangers, so their chains do not help this trophy. [1][2]
4. POSSIBLY MISSABLE (flagged, not confirmed): sources disagree on which 8 strands count and no guide lists all eight qualifiers, so start every stranger chain when it appears. [1][6]
5. All of them are findable after the story in free roam. [1]
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
1. Randy's questline (Randy's Wish List) is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which unlocks the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. [1][2]
2. Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered; track them under Map, then Robberies (money-bag icon), then Randy's Wish List, and look for the green RK icon in west Vice City. [1]
3. The cars are often parked or driving in east Vice City (Vice Beach / Ocean Beach); scan with WAiNK to check if a car is on the list, and deliver in good condition for more pay. [1]
4. It stays doable after the story. [1][5]
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
1. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. [1][2]
2. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy the labs (quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs). [1]
3. It stays available after the story, but it is Jason-only, so do it as him. [1][5]
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide:
1. Meditate at every spot across Leonida — guides say 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditate with BOTH Jason and Lucia at each spot, and each spot then counts twice. [1][2][3]
2. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation FIRST: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she will meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and accept the optional prompt. [1][2]
3. That balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 but is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and nobody has confirmed whether it is required for the trophy — so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1. [1][4]
4. The last spot needs both leads playable, which happens after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break). [1]
5. Track the count at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations — the counter on this page tracks 18. [1][5]
6. SOURCES DISAGREE: guides say 18 spots for the trophy, while the 100% list stops at 15 — both versions are shown, and the counter tracks 18. [1][3][6]
7. Push Square reports no missable trophy known, while PowerPyx flags this one as possibly missable — this guide shows both and plays it safe. [1][9]
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
1. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive it. [1][2]
2. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to Bret as Jason. [1]
3. The first quest gives the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. [1]
4. One clean shot leaves animals pristine and pays more, but it is not mandatory. [1]
5. Which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still unconfirmed — track it under Map, then Activities (dumbbell icon), then Target Deck; all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100%. [1][5]
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide:
1. Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — there are 18 card-set locations in total. [1][5]
2. Work one set at a time and use the map to see which locations you have cleared. [1]
3. All 18 locations stay available after the story, so there is no rush. [1]
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide:
1. WAiNK It at 100 locations — WAiNK scans are objects you scan (hold Up + R1), and more than 100 exist, so any 100 count. [1][5]
2. The breakdown is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags — sweep one kind at a time. [1][8]
3. Scan as you travel; the counter on this page tracks your total. [1]
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide:
1. Complete 50 challenges — 80 challenges exist, so only 50 are needed for this trophy. [1][5]
2. Track them at Progress, then Challenges (a checkmark at the bottom-right when scrolling over a challenge). [1]
3. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies; save this for late and pick the easiest remaining ones. [1]
4. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50. [1]
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
1. Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat — earliest after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), when free-roam together unlocks; call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. [1][2]
2. Get 4 stars (cause carnage), then escape in a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; shoot a chasing helicopter down if needed. [1]
3. Easiest: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) — cops struggle on train tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. [1]
4. The trophy pops after leaving the red heat wanted zone, not the blue/red flashing search area. [1][5]
5. It also unlocks on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) and large bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars. [1]
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — only after Coffee Break. [1][2]
2. Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while chased the whole time; keep the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level). [1]
3. Gear up first: armored vest and sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation), Zombix/Adrenaline for healing; call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). [1]
4. Good spot: the 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City (available after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); rob a couple of items in each, go to the back room, break the safe with sticky bombs. [1]
5. If it does not pop after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th — the pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop. [1][5]
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide:
1. Discover 100 vehicles — 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). [1][5]
2. Open the WAiNK app (hold Up to open instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan — scanning is enough, there is no need to drive them. [1]
3. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic to rack up the count fast. [1]
4. Track it at Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles. [1][8]
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
1. Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming a firearm; it slows time, highlights vulnerable spots and drains the purple focus bar. [1][2]
2. Buff focus first (food and drinks, wash your face or shower at home, Adrenaline to extend it). [1]
3. Line up 5 enemies (best at Gang Operations), defeat them quickly without missing; an assault rifle (Duke 556) is more accurate than pistols or SMGs, and body armor (Ammu-Nation) helps. [1]
4. It does NOT work on soldiers, police or civilians — only on enemies. [1]
5. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Focus, purple eye icon); raise it via Shooting Range challenges, Golf, Pool, fishing and headshots. Easier late; it may pop naturally. [1][5]
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
1. Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal, connected to a passenger boarding bridge, NOT the planes on the airfield. [1][2]
2. Easiest: the plane at departure terminals E3/E4; drive through a fence around the airfield, and stairs by the boarding bridge lead straight into the plane (or enter on foot through the terminal). [1]
3. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. [1][5]
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide:
1. Steal a military tank — tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map (Mariana County), in the south of the air base. [1][2]
2. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance; enter a tank and shoot enemies until it pops. [1][5]
3. Expect heavy resistance at the base — bring body armor and be ready to fight your way in and out. [1]
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
1. First finish Chapter 3 (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silently lockpick alarmed doors) and Jewelry Store Robberies (green icons in unfogged map areas). [1][2]
2. Break in through the backdoor with the Snap Gun — do not kick the door, that triggers the alarm. [1]
3. In the backroom: find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm; the trophy pops shortly after leaving the store. [1]
4. Good location: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, Vice City. [1][5]
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide:
1. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it introduces bank vault robberies, and the first one is done in the mission. [1][2]
2. Method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank; a guard carries a briefcase with cash into the bank and the vault opens — go in while it is open and rob it. [1]
3. Bring your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag — you cannot carry all the cash alone). [1]
4. After the quest, pay Yasmani (fence, unlocked Chapter 3) for security-van tips — $10,000 each, after doing his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans) — vans get a purple map icon. [1]
5. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. [1][5]
6. There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; 5 are needed for this trophy and all 8 for 100%; up to $205,000 per bank — the best endgame money. [1]
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob an Armored Truck and escape — it is unlocked automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck (you tail the truck to the bank). [1][2]
2. Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray after the robbery. [1]
3. All 8 Large Bank Jobs are needed for 100%, so this pops on its own while doing them. [1]
4. Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up; it pops only after escaping the red heat radius — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. [1][5]
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide:
1. Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map, best done by plane, flying over every black-fog area until the map is visible. [1][5]
2. SOURCES DISAGREE: the kit's starter list says all 52 areas of Leonida, while PowerPyx says fully unfog the whole map — both versions are shown. [1][8]
3. Do it as you travel for other trophies; a dedicated sweep by plane finishes the last foggy corners. [1]
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
1. Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, 39 Illegal Gang Operations in total; 1 per gang for this trophy. [1][5]
2. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when nearby, and many are marked automatically from story progress. [1]
3. Track it at Progress, then Gangs (scroll over a gang — bottom-right shows how many of its operations you robbed). [1]
4. All 39 are needed for 100%, so keep robbing after this trophy pops. [1]
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
1. Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar. [1][2]
2. Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. [1]
3. It pops right after drinking; it is one of the easiest trophies in the game. [1][5]
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
1. Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — steal the specific blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom's window. [1][2][5]
2. It requires the Key Cloner (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)). [1]
3. Only this blue Banshee works — an easter egg referencing the Banshee from GTA III; the pop is slightly delayed (after driving further away). [1]
4. WATCH: PowerPyx gives this full method, but other lists mark the trigger unconfirmed — this guide shows the method and flags that it is not pinned down by every source. [1][4]
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
1. Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling (Port Gellhorn), one of the Gang Operations. [1][2]
2. Buy sticky bombs first (Ammu-Nation — needed to blow the safe); the alley is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. [1]
3. Inside: (1) luxury watch, south-east office (golden icon); (2) unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850, north-east table (golden icon); (3) the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). [1]
4. It pops after escaping the police, not on picking up the third item; killing enemies is not necessary. [1][5]
5. NOT missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can return for the rest. [1]
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide:
1. Have maximum strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time — only after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), when character switching opens. [1][2]
2. Check strength at Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then select a character, then Strength (heart icon). [1]
3. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness-club membership; always go together with both characters (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner): while one works out, the other completes training automatically (double progress). [1]
4. Filter fitness clubs on Map, then Activities (dumbbell icon); many are across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story. [1][5]
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide:
1. Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — view the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. [1][2][5]
2. Turn on notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen when an action counts. [1]
3. Profiles: Professional (stealthy objectives/robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing — shooting limbs), Violent (killing enemies/civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops/civilians, driving over gravestones), Irredeemable (permanent, from excessive violence). [1][6]
4. It mostly pops passively while doing other trophies and 100%; if not, farm by running over civilians/cops with a car. [1]
5. Avoid the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent and cops shoot on sight more. [1][6]
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide:
1. UNCONFIRMED: the trigger for this trophy is currently unknown — this guide does not invent a method for it. [1][5]
2. The belief, stated as a belief only: it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. [1]
3. Until a source confirms it, treat any Payday Loans visit as a guess, not a guide — check the disagreement ledger for updates. [1]
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide:
1. Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, and come solo — this is the UFO easter egg. [1][2]
2. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed: at the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car; if it is not there, drive away and come back. [1]
3. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods — you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky); approach it and it drops an abducted woman. [1]
4. Talk to her and offer to help; she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and it pops. [1][5]
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
1. UNCONFIRMED: the trigger for this trophy is currently unknown — this guide does not invent a method for it. [1][5]
2. The belief, stated as a belief only: it is believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. [1]

trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
1. Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — first finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills. [1][2]
2. Then rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). [1]
3. The $250,000 total is cumulative — there is no need to bring it all at once — and it comes naturally while doing all robberies for 100%. [1]
4. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after Chapter 4, That's Where The Money Is…). [1][5]
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide:
1. Spend $100,000 across all shops — the total is cumulative. [1][5]
2. Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos (the most expensive items). [1]
3. Shop counts: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear Stores, 18 Hair & Beauty Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics Stores. [1]
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide:
1. Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages plus 4 story-related garages; only the 8 purchasable are needed, total cost $160,000. [1][2]
2. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — a notification says a new phone app was installed (Vice City Real Estate); buy the garages through the phone app. [1]
3. Fast money: robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. [1][5]
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
1. Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the app is installed on the phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), and lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. [1][2]
2. You need enough garages first (see trophy 54) — each garage adds 1+ parking spots. [1]
3. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register — Moses is unlocked by the same mission. [1]
4. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray; registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses low. [1][5]
trophies.name: On the Spot
